text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan, who was hailed as today's "promising rookie"!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: To get right to it, what are your future goals?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan will claim
the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoa...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had her debut race ended than a press scrum began around her.
Excitement rippled through the crowd toward her grand ambition.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
That's a wonderful goal!
If you've decided on your next race entry, please let us know!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The next one, is it? Hmm.
choice_data_list: (I don't think we've discussed it yet, though...)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The Fantasy Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed her mind
was already made up.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I see!
By the way, may I ask your reason for that?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because its name is lovely.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is going to be a mascot,
so loveliness is a must."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Would you still call udon 'udon' if it had no noodles in it?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Huh? U-Udon...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Keeping up that momentum, Aston Machan left a lasting impression that day, both in the race and during the press scrum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Especially during the race—
the eyes of the crowd belonged entirely to her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that Aston Machan girl...
Her leg turnover is incredible. That's a pitch running style... right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
She was all smiles when entering the gate, wasn't she?
Who knew she'd run with such fierce determination.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The road to becoming an Ultra Super Mascot
is veeeery long, you know."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If we don't try every conceivable option,
we won't make it in time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she said before,
she refuses to cut corners on a single thing.
choice_data_list: (Maybe there's something I can do as well...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As it stands, I haven't even been able to be someone she can truly rely on,
especially before races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides training,
is there anything I can do to help her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I jot down ideas in the notepad in my hand.
Media feature requests, active social media use,
fan meet-and-greets—
choice_data_list: No, it needs to be a little more out-of-the-box...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Doing what everyone else does is pointless.
If you want to leave a real impact, you have to stand out.
So, with that in mind—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A handmade Chan-me doll?
Th-Thank you so much...
Wow, the craftsmanship is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still, why are you here?
Did Chan ask you to come?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking around handing out handmade Chan-me dolls—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I was wondering what that was...
It's just a Chan costume!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Why is something like this here... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is the person inside...
Machan's Trainer?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We did a lap around the neighborhood
in the Aston Machan mascot costume, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clang... Clang...)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan, was it?
What a wonderful bronze statue.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Setting that aside.
Could you come to the Director's office for a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bronze statue of Aston Machan was made,
only to be removed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting that I might have gone a bit too far,
I tentatively brought it up to Aston Machan, and—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Incredible momentum!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A round of applause and an ultra-standing ovation
for our consummate professional of a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Therefore, please accompany me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let us go to Onigashima to persuade the ogres.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Well...
Making it the official mascot at this stage would be tough, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is that a no?

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
As you know, our policy is basically to pick Umamusume
who have achieved particularly outstanding race records
or gained immense popularity.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'm not saying Aston Machan isn't charming!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text: She's still freshly debuted, so if we force our way through here, it might come across as unfair.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...
Unfairness is not good, is it?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll come back and try again...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
To become a fair and impartial Chan...
What is needed for this is... reliable results.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, our first goal is
to put on a stellar performance in the upcoming Fantasy Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And after that, I shall keep achieving great feats.
I shall build a towering monument of accomplishments.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, I'm sure they'll eventually
turn me into a mascot...!"
choice_data_list: First, let's do our best to get one win!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll do this, hmph!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With this momentum, first is the Fantasy Stakes.
And then, I want to take on the Triple Tiara."
